machine.cpu: Intel Core i7-9700K, 8 cores, 95 W TDP

model: torchvision RetinaNet ResNet-50 FPN, COCO_V1 weights (retinanet_resnet50_fpn_coco-eeacb38b.pth, 34,014,999 parameters), fp32
images: 300 synthetic 1280x720 frames (seed 2026, measure_tagging.frames) x 4 passes = 1200 images a run, batches of 4
counted: frames in memory to the GPU, the model's own resize (shorter side 800) and normalisation, detection, and boxes, labels and scores above 0.5 back to the CPU; file reading and decoding not counted
accuracy: not measured: the frames are synthetic and have no ground truth; only energy and throughput are
meter: nvidia-smi power.draw (board power, instantaneous on Turing, +/- 5 W) and utilization.gpu every 100 ms; energy by trapezoids over the run, minus the mean idle baseline sampled just before it
gate: each run starts only with the GPU below 5 % and no Blender process on it
scaling_rule: equal energy per item on the 1 kW reference server (equal performance per watt): images per server-hour = 1,000 Wh / Wh per image, with Wh per image = (GPU above idle + CPU share) / images

runs.cpu_method: RAPL not readable without root; this process's CPU seconds above baseline x 11.9 W per busy core (95 W TDP / 8 cores, stated, not metered)
